chunks: (32) Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated to me, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, and Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, all of them saying: Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated to us, from Ab al-Jarud, from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him) who said:

You will keep stretching your necks towards one of us, saying: 'It is he.' And Allah will take him (away), until Allah sends for this matter one whom you do not know whether he was born or not, whether he was created or not.

key_terms.الْأَمْرُ: the matter/command (referring to the Imamate or leadership)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about the future leader whose birth was unknown?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (as) uses the phrase 'not yet known if born or created' to signify the transition from the Lesser to the Greater Occultation, where the Imam's identity becomes hidden from general knowledge. This hadith underscores the theological concept of the 'Ghaybah al-Kubra' as a period of divine concealment preceding the reappearance of the Mahdi (as).
